module Base

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *
     * Off-Grid recipes. GENERATED by tools/build_scripts.py.
     *
     * All NeedToBeLearn, taught only by the two handbooks, with no AutoLearn
     * at any level: the gate is finding a book, not grinding Electricity.
     * Once one is read, the skill requirements are what stop you building the
     * whole system on day one.
     *
     * Grammar follows the shipped B42 electrical recipes verbatim
     * (media/scripts/generated/recipes/recipes_electrical.txt).
     * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

    craftRecipe MakeOffGridArraySalvage
    {
        timedAction     = MakingElectrical,
        time            = 550,
        NeedToBeLearn   = true,
        SkillRequired   = Electricity:2,
        Tags            = AnySurfaceCraft,
        category        = Electrical,
        xpAward         = Electricity:20,
        inputs
        {
            item 1 tags[base:screwdriver] mode:keep flags[Prop1],
            item 1 tags[base:pliers] mode:keep flags[MayDegradeVeryLight],
            item 2 [Base.ElectronicsScrap],
            item 3 [Base.SmallSheetMetal],
            item 2 [Base.Wire],
            item 4 [Base.Screws],
            item 2 [Base.DuctTape],
        }
        outputs
        {
            item 1 Base.OffGridArraySalvage,
        }
    }

    /* Salvage. A cracked array is worth pulling apart rather than hauling
       around, and it is the only way to get anything back out of one. */

    craftRecipe ScrapOffGridArraySalvage
    {
        timedAction     = DismantleElectrical,
        time            = 400,
        Tags            = AnySurfaceCraft,
        category        = Electrical,
        xpAward         = Electricity:10,
        inputs
        {
            item 1 tags[base:screwdriver] mode:keep flags[Prop1],
            item 1 [Base.OffGridArraySalvage] mode:destroy,
        }
        outputs
        {
            item 1 Base.ElectronicsScrap,
            item 1 Base.SmallSheetMetal,
        }
    }
